nordic_runes.help_content:
🔮 **IGORRR'S BREAD RUNES** 🔮

**What are the Bread Runes?**
HUH! They are runes I write on bread dough and bake so destiny reveals itself in burnt crumbs. The Master says they serve to see the future... or at least that's what I tell the flour sacks to make them give me wheat sacks.

**Available Readings:**
• **Single Ash** - Quick guidance for a specific question
• **Three Ashes** - Past, Present, Future of the flour sack
• **Five Ash Cross** - Complete situation analysis

**How to use?:**
• Use the kommands: `!runes cast [type] <question>`!
• Example: `!runes cast single what should I steal today?`!

**The 24 Sacred Oven Ashes:**
Fehu • Uruz • Thurisaz • Ansuz • Raidho • Kenaz • Gebo • Wunjo
Hagalaz • Nauthiz • Isa • Jera • Eiwaz • Perthro • Algiz • Sowilo
Tiwaz • Berkano • Ehwaz • Mannaz • Laguz • Ingwaz • Dagaz • Othala

Each ash carries ancient wisdom for your oven path!
nordic_runes.types_content:
🔮 **ASH CASTING TYPES** 🔮

**single** - Single Ash
└ Quick guidance for a specific question - Uses 1 ash

**three** - Three Ashes
└ Past, Present, Future reading - Uses 3 ashes

**cross** - Five Ash Cross
└ Complete situation analysis - Uses 5 ashes

**runic_cross** - Runic Cross
└ Seven ash deep reading for spiritual guidance - Uses 7 ashes

**Usage Examples:**
`!runes cast single what should I steal today?`
`!runes cast three will the Master discover me?`
`!runes cast cross Help me understand my current misery`

SSSSS! Choose your casting and ask the oven ashes!
